name: Gravedigger
text: You remember the weight of a spade, and soil that had to be turned twice. The dead never frightened you. Their echoes feed you.

name: Lamplighter
text: You remember climbing ladders at dusk, and the smell of lamp-oil on your hands. You know exactly how far a flask can be thrown.

name: Cutpurse
text: You remember crowds, and the exact moment a stranger looks away. You were never there when they looked back.
